system_world_experiment.System: Specific modeled focal actor's internal bounded policy/value, belief about modeled opponent and its within-agent inference steps. Multi-agent model has explicitly partitioned simulated internal agent index; do not treat actual human and computer jointly as one cognitive subject.
system_world_experiment.World_W: Observed other actor's actual behavior, stag/prey reward/payoff and game board; these are exogenous constraints and observations relative to focal human.
system_world_experiment.Gamma: Actual actor action-to-game external effect and external game observations-to-model input; simulations specifying multiple agents are NOT proof of novel internal-to-world self-evolving cybernetic feedback.
system_world_experiment.E_exp: Experimenter fixes two computer strategies, task timing and 4 blocks/10 rounds and records behavior for separate model comparison; E_exp intervention not an invented cognitive component.
system_world_experiment.source_scope_limit: No source-defined persistent additional coordination agent/controller; original nested ToM and Bayesian update are already part of article. Prosocial equilibrium counterexample prevents uniquely inferring cognitive ToM from same equilibrium.

A0_A1_A2_order.reason: Original actor-specific value and opponent-posterior recursion directly compose in source equations; scope only this source not universal cognitive necessity.
Source already encodes relevant conditional transformations; no additional adapter beyond declared equations is source-grounded.

Neither an extra persistent coordinator beyond existing source-specified agent beliefs nor a novel hidden operator appears; source experiment and prosocial alternative are counterexamples to strong claim.
